The crash is a stack-buffer-overflow READ 8 in asn1_decode_entry. The 8-byte read suggests the vulnerable code path reads 8 bytes from a stack buffer that is smaller than 8 bytes, or reads past the end of a stack buffer into adjacent memory.

The crash occurs during ASN.1 decoding of attacker-controlled APDU response data. The stack-buffer-overflow READ 8 is triggered when the decoder reads 8 bytes from a stack-allocated buffer that has insufficient space, caused by malformed ASN.1 length or tag values in the input.
